metadata.title: Medken synthetic finding follow-through test set
metadata.synthetic_notice: Entirely synthetic. No real patient data. Names, dates and reports are invented.
metadata.shape: Records follow the FT-DM candidate fields in MA_Finding-Follow-Through_Candidate-Requirements-and-Data-Model v0.2 (Requirements/).

conventions.clock: Clock face as viewed facing the patient. Right breast: 9:00 lateral, 3:00 medial. Left breast: 3:00 lateral, 9:00 medial.
conventions.boundaries: 12:00, 3:00, 6:00, 9:00 lie on quadrant boundaries and are compatible with both adjacent quadrants. 'central' = retroareolar/subareolar; no clock. 'upper'/'lower' alone = one-view finding, medial/lateral unknown. Axilla is a separate site.
conventions.depth: anterior / middle / posterior third; ABUS states depth from skin instead.
conventions.fn_cm: distance from nipple, cm. Mammography measures under compression; US face-up; MRI face-down uncompressed. Expect disagreement across modalities for one lesion.
conventions.view_basis: both · CC · MLO · spot compression · magnification · DBT-only · low-energy · recombined · ABUS · post-contrast · T2 · null (= not stated, read as both views)
conventions.finding_type: mass · calcifications · asymmetry · focal asymmetry · architectural distortion · non-mass enhancement · duct ectasia · lymph node · no correlate (negative search record) · specimen (pathology)
conventions.correspondence: polarity affirmed|negated; certainty stated|hedged; target_text = the radiologist's words; source_span = the clause. The MDE delivers the words; MA resolves which finding they denote.
conventions.status_statement: new · persists · stable · increased · decreased · resolved · no longer visualized. Matching input only; never sets a finding's conclusion.
conventions.literals: assessment_literal and recommendation_literal are exact text, never inferred.
conventions.specimen: one record per pathology part; specimen_kind core · vacuum · FNA · excision; clip_statement verbatim where present.
conventions.ranges: A clock range is written 'h:mm-h:mm' and fn_cm as a string 'a-b' when the report states a range; otherwise clock is 'h:mm' and fn_cm a number.
conventions.retrospective_note: Free text on a finding when the report says it was visible in retrospect on a prior; a note, never a link.
conventions.record_fields: finding_id, exam_id, modality, laterality, site, finding_type, location{...}, size_mm, descriptors, status_statement, correspondence[], assessment_literal, recommendation_literal, specimen (PATH only), retrospective_note (rare).
conventions.record_rule: Each finding statement is one record, as stated, no inference. Combined reports yield separate records per modality section. Negative searches are records of type 'no correlate'.

files.reports: reports.json / reports.md — the report texts per case and exam
files.records: records_clean.json — the extracted records (clean layer; what a perfect MDE would deliver)
files.answer_key: answer_key.json — ground truth; keep closed until results are in
files.index: Synthetic_Finding_Cases_v0.2.xlsx — narratives, one row per case
